mlbbhotpotus.com — MLBB / Malubianbian's former US website — no longer resolves to the brand; as of 2026-10-17 it serves an unrelated parked blog (online-gambling / SBOBET content). Evidence the US operation has wound down, alongside 7 of 8 US outlets closed (sole survivor: Orlando, FL).

Mixue Hong Kong scaled back in 2026: closed 6 stores, down from a peak of 9 to 3 (as of Oct 2026); its first store (Mong Kok) was dismantled. Per CNA (https://www.cna.com.tw/news/acn/202610080372.aspx, 8 Oct 2026) citing a Hong Kong Economic Journal commentary that frames the HK presence as a post-IPO unwind.

ChaPanda (茶百道, HKEX:2555) suspended from trading on 13 Oct 2026 by HKEX on a Hong Kong SFC order over suspected IPO share-demand manipulation; the SFC froze up to HK$4.379bn of 'Sun Ran Group' assets (a record) and shares were ~77% below issue. Offline stores operate normally. Per HK01 (13 Oct 2026) and Chinese financial press.

CTEE (14 Oct 2026): ChaPanda's HKEX suspension is part of a broader SFC fraud/manipulation case over three IPOs (茶百道 ChaPanda, 撥康視雲 BoKang Shiyun, 天聚地合 Tianju Dihe) — alleging IPO proceeds were diverted via non-public agreements into financial products then funneled back to major placees; ~HK$5bn frozen across the case (a record); ChaPanda reportedly dropped from the Hang Seng Index; shares ~70%+ below issue.

Operator-observed verification (Google, Oct 2026) finds ~8 OPEN Mixue HK stores plus 1 permanently closed (Bank Centre, 636 Nathan Rd, Mong Kok — the first HK store) — contradicting the 8 Oct 2026 HK Economic Journal / CNA commentary's claim of a cut to 3 (closed 6 of a peak 9). Only the Bank Centre closure is confirmed; the '3 remaining' figure is not supported by operator-observed listings. HK count corrected 3 -> 8.

西塔老太太 / Mama Xita BBQ (mamaxita) has FULLY EXITED Hong Kong by Oct 2026 — both HK stores closed after under 3 years: TST East (Mandarin Centre, opened Sept 2023) permanently closed, and Tseung Kwan O (Metro City, Oct 2024) foreclosed/auctioned amid rent disputes. Per stheadline + HK01. US outlets (Bellevue WA, Temple City CA) unaffected.
